displayName: Kroger Grocery Data API - Search, Store Prices, Coupons, QFC + Fred Meyer
description: Kroger grocery data as structured JSON for kroger.com and the QFC and Fred Meyer banners - product search and category listings (first page, up to 24 products) with price, promo price, multi-buy, unit price, stock level, SNAP eligibility and star ratings; full product detail with nutrition, ingredients, allergens and aisle; price, promotion, stock, aisle and fulfillment for up to 25 UPCs at the store you choose; a store locator; this week's digital deals; a store's digital coupons (listed, never clipped); and search suggestions. Prices in integer cents. 8 endpoints, 1 to 3 credits each.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
